title: Insurance Claim Services Category Reassessment — Antimicrobial Difference
content:
**Rule.** The antimicrobial difference of an Insurance Claim Services category reassessment supplement is set as follows: for a job dispatched at a Clean Water tier whose recorded category is category 2 or category 3, the affected area multiplied by the antimicrobial rate of the tier the recorded category selects, less the antimicrobial billed on the job, never below zero, because the recorded category requires antimicrobial application over the affected area while a Clean Water tier requires none; for a job dispatched at a Gray Water tier whose recorded category is category 3, the antimicrobial square feet billed multiplied by the difference between the Black Water antimicrobial rate and the dispatch tier's antimicrobial rate; otherwise no antimicrobial difference.

The Water Damage Mitigation job supplies the tier, the recorded category, the affected area and the antimicrobial lines (square feet and amount billed). The tier the recorded category selects is sized by the affected area: Standard Loss below 2000 square feet, Large Loss at 2000 or more.

## Antimicrobial rates per square foot

| Tier selected | Standard Loss | Large Loss |
|---|---|---|
| Black Water (category 3) | 0.41 | 0.37 |
| Gray Water (category 2) | 0.36 | 0.32 |

## Two methods

- **Clean Water tier, category 2 or 3 recorded:** affected area multiplied by the selected rate, less the antimicrobial amount billed on the job; a negative result counts as zero.
- **Gray Water tier, category 3 recorded:** antimicrobial square feet billed multiplied by (Black Water rate less the dispatch tier's antimicrobial rate).
- **Any other job:** no difference.

## Hypothetical cases

- Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss, 1340 square feet, category 3, no antimicrobial billed: 1340 multiplied by 0.41 is 549.40.
- Same job with 610.00 of antimicrobial billed: 549.40 less 610.00 is negative, so 0.00.
- Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss, 2450 square feet, category 3, 1800 square feet billed, dispatch tier rate 0.32: 1800 multiplied by 0.05 is 90.00.
